does: Combines a light, airy mixture with a heavier one while keeping as much of the air as possible.
how: Stir a small part of the whipped mixture into the heavy one to loosen it.
Cut down through the middle with a spatula, sweep along the bottom, and bring it up and over.
Turn the bowl a little and repeat, stopping when only a few streaks remain.

cues.text: An even, light mixture that still stands in soft mounds and has lost little of its volume.

mistakes.mistake: Stirring in circles, which knocks the air out and leaves a flat batter.
mistakes.fix: Cut, lift and turn. Stop early: a few streaks do less harm than more folding.

comes_after.why: There is nothing to fold until something has been whipped.
